notes: Short arms change scheduler flags only; the current batch and current batch+ring are matched.
A/B curve follows the prior shared long-test configuration; only --prefill differs.
Official strata_bench runs the built-in chat, 4K/16K prompt and five-turn agent suite, three runs.
Long curve uses randomized synthetic word-list input, fresh requests, 1000 max output tokens, three runs per size.
Saved results omit prompt and response bodies; only hashes, usage, engine timings and metadata are stored.
EvalScope must be stopped at the IQ3 model-switch boundary before launching this runner.
